paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to request further information about an online study workshop. I am interested in online university classes and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to request further information about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am interested in [chủ đề] and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.label: Nhu cầu
paragraphs.text: My main concern is that I have limited experience and would prefer a practical introduction. I understand that participants will try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. This interests me because students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift.
